scripts.setup: node scripts/check-node.cjs && node scripts/ensure-root-env.cjs && npm install --prefix client && npm run db:up
scripts.setup:local: node scripts/check-node.cjs && node scripts/ensure-root-env.cjs && npm install --prefix client
scripts.db:up: node scripts/ensure-root-env.cjs && docker compose up -d postgres
scripts.dev:server: bash -lc 'set -a; [ -f ./.env ] && source ./.env; set +a; mvn -f backend-java/pom.xml spring-boot:run'
scripts.build: bash -lc 'set -a; [ -f ./.env ] && source ./.env; set +a; mvn -f backend-java/pom.xml -DskipTests package' && npm run build --prefix client
